dependencies.name: SDL
dependencies.purpose: Windows, input, events, Vulkan surface creation (engine/platform)

dependencies.name: Vulkan Memory Allocator (VMA)
dependencies.purpose: GPU memory allocation for buffers and images (engine/render)

dependencies.name: nlohmann/json
dependencies.purpose: JSON for projects, scenes and asset metadata (ADR-005)

dependencies.name: DirectX Shader Compiler (dxc, from the Vulkan SDK)
dependencies.purpose: Compiles HLSL shaders to SPIR-V during the build

dependencies.name: Vulkan SDK (loader + headers)
dependencies.linkage: dynamic (vulkan-1.dll is provided by the GPU driver)
dependencies.purpose: Graphics API; installed by developer, runtime loader comes with drivers

dependencies.name: Avalonia (+ Desktop, Themes.Fluent)
dependencies.purpose: Editor GUI toolkit (ADR-003). Currently used by spikes/avalonia_viewport

dependencies.name: Avalonia.Fonts.Inter (Inter typeface)
dependencies.purpose: Editor UI typeface; OFL bundling allowed per ADR-019

dependencies.name: Dock (Dock.Avalonia, Dock.Model.Mvvm, Dock.Avalonia.Themes.Fluent)
dependencies.purpose: Editor docking panels and floating windows (ADR-003)

dependencies.name: AvaloniaEdit (Avalonia.AvaloniaEdit)
dependencies.purpose: NoorCode's text editor control (highlighting, search); ADR-003 named it

dependencies.name: Luau
dependencies.purpose: Lua scripting: compiler and sandboxed VM (engine/scripting, ADR-009)

dependencies.name: Jolt Physics
dependencies.purpose: Physics: rigid bodies, colliders, queries, character controller (engine/physics, ADR-010)

dependencies.name: miniaudio
dependencies.purpose: Audio: devices, decoding (WAV/FLAC/MP3), mixing, buses, 3D sound (engine/audio, ADR-011)

dependencies.name: stb_truetype
dependencies.purpose: HUD text: TrueType parsing and signed-distance-field glyphs (engine/game)

dependencies.name: stb_image and stb_image_write
dependencies.purpose: stb_image: texture decoding in the engine (ADR-029). stb_image_write: tests only (PNG references, test images)

dependencies.name: Atkinson Hyperlegible Regular
dependencies.license: SIL OFL 1.1 (Copyright 2020 Braille Institute of America, Inc.)
dependencies.purpose: The default HUD font, built into the engine; licence text in third_party/fonts/OFL.txt

dependencies.name: Poly Haven HDRIs (Studio Small 09, Kloppenheim 06, Venice Sunset)
dependencies.purpose: Render tests for image-based lighting (Milestone 5, part 5)

dependencies.name: bc7enc and rgbcx (from bc7enc_rdo)
dependencies.license: MIT or public domain / Unlicense (dual); bc7e.ispc (Apache-2.0) is not used
dependencies.linkage: static (bc7enc.cpp, bc7decomp.cpp, rgbcx.cpp; each file pinned by SHA-256)
dependencies.purpose: Texture compression on the CPU: BC7 (colour, ORM/data) and BC5 (normal maps), and decoding for tests and for GPUs without BC support (ADR-029)
